plugins.name: sales-engine
plugins.description: 5 Claude Code skills that execute the sales block of a GTM system for B2B service companies: pre-call meeting prep (≤500-word briefs), cold-call scripts, meeting-intent scoring (is this meeting worth prepping), value proposition listing, and pipeline analysis with actionable follow-ups. Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
